newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan conglomerate ONA Group 1996 profit down.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan conglomerate ONA Group 1996 profit down.

text.p: Moroccan conglomerate ONA Group reported provisional non-consolidated audited figures for 1996 on Thursday showing net profits of 208 million dirhams ($22.36 million) from 266.6 million in 1995.
Turnover for 1996 stood at 53.9 million dirhams. No comparative figure for the previous year was available.

The company, established in 1919 is headed by Fouad Filali, son of Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali and King Hassan's son-in-law. It has interests in more than 100 companies notably sugar firm, dairy concern, edible oil and Finance Diwan which are listed on the bourse.
One of the 47 stocks to be listed on the casablanca stock exchange, it was traded at 760 dirhams on March 26.
